interpretation: Fixed retained-data display policy, not a physical requirement or an optimization gate.
threshold: Upper fraction of full eligible raw-value range, not a count or area quantile.
excess_baseline: Whole original eligible field above its fixed half-range threshold.
area_and_integral_denominator: Complete original eligible source field; exact clipped original-triangle contributions.
colorbar: Unchanged full raw domain; no crop-local normalization.
missingness: Original per-field masks, typed missingness and genuine zeros preserved.
hotspots: All threshold ties, all maxima and disconnected support; full-context fallback if no compact truthful crop.
locator: Original plate outer/hole boundary; red quadrilateral is the exact displayed source-coordinate viewport. Lateral/torsion context camera is wider than the separately recorded saliency-selection ROI. Not authenticated detailed CAD silhouette.
